scope: First bounded batch of versioned historical claims and separately declared comparators; not a complete corpus or validated cosmology.
path_convention: Local paths in audit_refs and formulation.test_refs are relative to workspace_root, not to this JSON file.
evidence_rules: Text evidence may be an original indexed passage, publisher transcription, later reformatted mirror, or an attributed excerpt. The subtype is explicit.
A bibliographic work year does not authenticate every passage as present in that first edition.
Source terms and quantities are distinct from modern variable definitions, equations and synthetic inputs.
Unknown units, medium, uncertainty, image correspondence and dates remain null.
Source access failures are not claims that material is absent from every archive.
No historical term or number is a calibration of a legacy mapper or the canonical Matrix clock.

preserved_authoritative_numeric_records.relationship: The new catalog cross-references these five records; it does not replace or silently correct them.

records.author: Walter Russell
records.edition: Undated USP web transcription of the 1930 work; not an original-page facsimile

inspected_location.description: Opening force definitions, before The Solar Gravitational Experiment

records.evidence_detail: publisher-hosted authored transcription
records.claim_summary: The text pairs electricity with gravitation and magnetism with radiation as opposing generating and dispersing effects.
records.modern_mapping: Any mapping to E, B or a gravitational field is an additional operational definition, not supplied by the equality of names.

known_conflicts.detail: 1939 uses two electric signs for the paired processes.
Later magnetic Light is assigned a still controlling role.

formulation.proposal: Specify a force law before comparing signed particle deflection or field work; use velocity reversal to separate qE from q(v cross B).
